understanding how the human body copes with exercise above critical power ( CP ), a point on the power–duration curve at which the body can no longer meet the demands of the task, and how it is that some people are better at this than others.
understanding the physiological mechanisms that underpin the performance of prolonged exercise.
understanding the mechanisms of fatigue during supra‐critical power exercise.
